repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true))
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the sensor only at the start of the 1s cycle. The IR requires a rising-edge wait. Evidence F2 shows at t=100ms the IR emitted the action while the candidate did nothing because the `if` condition was already true at t=0 and the code inside the `if` block was not reached until the next cycle iteration.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a blocking `wait until` for the rising edge. This ensures the body executes immediately when the transition from false to true occurs, matching the IR's rising-edge semantics.
